sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-265.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 265 was established by Ordinance No. 19478, passed by the Dallas City Council on February 25, 1987. Ordinance No. 19478 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 19478; 25711)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-265.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 265 is established on property generally fronting on the west line of Cheyenne Road, south of the south line of Limestone Road. The size of PD 265 is approximately 4.38 acres. (Ord. Nos. 19478; 25711)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-265.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25711)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-265.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Utilization of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 265A). (Ord. Nos. 19478; 25711)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-265.105. USES.

The only uses permitted on the Property are as follows:

(1) Residential units for ambulatory persons 55 years of age or older.

(2) Community center (private). The following uses are specifically permitted accessory uses as a part of the community center, provided they are exclusively for the service of the residents on the Property:

(A) Kitchen.

(B) Dining room.

(C) TV room.

(D) Lounge area.

(E) Game room.

(F) Crafts room.

(G) Beauty/barber shop.

(H) Laundry room.

(I) Retail store. (Ord. Nos. 19478; 25711)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-265.106. LANDSCAPING.

Landscaping must be provided as shown on the landscape plan (Exhibit 265B). All landscaping must be installed prior to the issuance of a certificate of occupancy for any use on the Property. All plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition at all times. (Ord. Nos. 19478; 25711)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-265.107. OFF-STREET PARKING.

Off-street parking must be provided in accordance with the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 19478; 25711)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-265.108. PAVING.

All parking spaces, aisles, maneuvering areas, and driveway connections to streets or alleys, whether enclosed or unenclosed, must be surfaced to comply with the standards set out in Chapter 51. (Ord. Nos. 19478; 25711)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-265.109. SIGNS.

All signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Article VII. (Ord. Nos. 19478; 25711)

sections.title: Screening
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-265.110. SCREENING.

A six-foot-high screening wall or fence must be installed and maintained along the interior boundary of the Property. No openings are permitted in the fence except that a gate is permitted to permit access from the Property to the church to the north. (Ord. Nos. 19478; 25711)

sections.title: Floor Area And Density
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-265.111. FLOOR AREA AND DENSITY.

(a) Residential uses.

(1) Floor area. Maximum permitted floor area for all residential uses combined is 48,320 square feet.

(2) Density. No more than 58 dwelling units are permitted on the Property.

(b) Community center uses. Maximum permitted floor area for all community center uses combined is 8,000 square feet. (Ord. Nos. 19478; 25711)

sections.title: Height
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-265.112. HEIGHT.

(a) Duplex and fourplex structures, as shown on the development plan, may not exceed 18 feet in height.

(b) The lodge building, as shown on the development plan, may not exceed 30 feet in height. (Ord. Nos. 19478; 25711)

sections.title: Stories
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-265.113. STORIES.

(a) Duplex and fourplex structures, as shown on the development plan, may not exceed one story.

(b) The lodge building, as shown on the development plan, may not exceed two stories. (Ord. Nos. 19478; 25711)

sections.title: Setbacks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-265.114. SETBACKS.

Minimum setbacks for structures on the Property are as shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 19478; 25711)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-265.115. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

(a) Utilization of the Property must comply with the requirements of all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city.

(b) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(c) The building official shall not issue a building permit or a certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this ordinance, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 19478; 25711)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-265.116. ZONING MAP.

PD 265 is located on Zoning Map No. L-11. (Ord. Nos. 19478; 25711)
